items.evidence: Log lines 2-82: block set to 4 C with lid open, then for each well A1-H1 a 1 uL aspirate from plasmid_plate and dispense into the matching transformation_plate well.
Log 83-86: lid closed, then 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s, and a 2 min return to 4 C, all on the thermocycler.
Log 88-167: 50 uL SOC dispensed into each of A1-H1 after the heat shock. Log 168-170: lid closed, then 37 C held for 60 min.
Log shows a pick up and drop tip pair for each of the 8 plasmid transfers and each of the 8 SOC additions. No tip is reused across wells, and none is held at the end.

The LV volumes (1/10/50 uL), 4 C 30 min, 42 C 30 s and 37 C 1 h all match the paper. The added mixing and the 2 min return to 4 C are flagged as CHOICE comments and are acceptable adaptations, and the citation is accurate.

judge.summary: The simulator log shows 1 uL DNA added to each cell well at 4 C, then 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s, 50 uL SOC per well and 37 C for 1 h with a fresh tip every time. The only additions are gentle mixing and a short post-shock return to 4 C, both labelled as choices, so I scored every item as a pass.
